**Best move:** Nxe3

**Main line:** Nxe3 fxe3 Rxd1+ Kh2 (or any king move)

**Motif:** fork

**Explanation:**
Your knight on d5 can capture the pawn with check to two pieces—the queen on c4 and the undefended rook on d1. After White recaptures the knight (fxe3 is best), you play Rxd1+ and win the rook with check, gaining material decisively. Always scan where your pieces can land and count what they attack; a fork attacking two targets at once is often the strongest move.
